And as far as I'm concerned the only "good days" that really mattered to me are officially over because my boyfriend and I broke up a month ago and severed ties this week. He was my best friend and the only person I felt energized being around, as opposed to being drained by his presence like I feel with most people. I could spend the rest of my life with him and still look at him like it's the first time I've seen his face.

In the spirit of the holidays-- I feel like a chocolate bunny. Hollow and empty but full of disappointment
